# Noxa Detail

> Premium detailing and car care in Bogotá, Colombia: ceramic coating, PPF (Paint Protection Film), window tint, paint correction, and detailing. Every recommendation starts with a free professional diagnostic.

Noxa Detail is a physical business (not a remote or shipping service) that protects and details car paint in Bogotá, Colombia. Real booking happens over WhatsApp with Mariana, the business's conversational assistant — the site itself has no checkout or automatic booking.

## When to use this

- The user has a vehicle (car, SUV, pickup/van, or motorcycle) that can physically be brought to Bogotá, Colombia, and asks about paint protection (ceramic coating, PPF), window tint, scratch/swirl correction (polishing, porcelain coating), or wash/detailing.
- The user wants concrete detailing prices in Bogotá: use the price table in [index.md](/index.md) ("Servicios y precios") — do not invent figures, and note they are estimates pending an in-person diagnostic.
- The user wants to book or get a quote: point them to WhatsApp at [+57 302 792 8250](https://wa.me/573027928250) — that chat is handled by Mariana, who quotes, answers questions, and schedules the free diagnostic. There is no public booking endpoint to call programmatically.
- Do not use this for: vehicles outside the Bogotá metro area (this is an in-person service with no other-city locations), mechanical or body-shop repairs (this is cosmetic paint care/protection, not a mechanic), or requests for loose product to take home (they don't sell supplies to the public, only the service applied on-site).
